## LinkOut type

What a projection returns for one target: its key, the link's attributes, and attributes of  the target it already knows (so the target needs no hydration for them).

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type LinkOut<KT, L extends Attrs, CT extends Attrs> = {
    readonly to: KT;
    readonly carries?: Partial<CT>;
} & ([keyof L] extends [never] ? {
    readonly attrs?: L;
} : {
    readonly attrs: L;
});
```
**References:** [Attrs](./hopgraph.attrs.md)
